text:
```yaml
name: Go CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ develop, main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ '*' ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go 1.26
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.26'
        cache: true

    - name: Migrate repository with go fix
      run: go fix ./...

    - name: Run tests
      run: make test

    - name: Check for vulnerabilities
      uses: golang/govulncheck-action@b625fbe08f3bccbe446d94fbf87fcc875a4f50ee
      with:
        go-version-input: '1.26'

    - name: Summarize test results
      uses: test-summary/action@v2
      with:
        paths: '**/test-results.xml'

  pr-checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Go 1.26
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.26'
        cache: true

    - name: Run pre-commit checks
      run: make precommit

    - name: Run linter
      run: make lint

    - name: Run tests without race detector
      run: make test-race=off

    - name: Check for vulnerabilities
      uses: golang/govulncheck-action@b625fbe08f3bccbe446d94fbf87fcc875a4f50ee
      with:
        go-version-input: '1.26'

    - name: Summarize test results
      uses: test-summary/action@v2
      with:
        paths: '**/test-results.xml'
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file implements the requested changes for the `autobrr/qui` repository. It sets up Go 1.26, migrates the repository using `go fix`, runs tests, checks for vulnerabilities, and summarizes test results. The PR checks job skips the race detector for pull requests while running other checks on `develop` and `main` branches.
